intervals.label: installation in the FAIR tunnels (first project stage)
intervals.note: Year precision ("since early 2024"); the FAIR page says FAIR "is being built in Darmstadt" without a start date.
intervals.quote: Installation work in the FAIR accelerator tunnels and supply buildings has been ongoing since early 2024.

intervals.label: beam commissioning (planned)
intervals.note: A schedule, not an event (IPAC 2025 paper): cryogenic plant commissioning from 2025, transport line end of 2025, beam commissioning in the second half of 2027.
intervals.quote: beam commissioning is scheduled for the second half of 2027

name: SIS100 superconducting synchrotron
notes: Status as of 2026-10-26 from the IPAC 2025 paper (arXiv:2510.14948, October 2025): the first project stage includes the SIS100, the Super-FRS and beam transport lines; "First Science" and "First Science +" stage definitions are not recorded here.

circumference.quote: The SIS100 has a circumference of 1,100 meters

summary.plain: SIS100 is the central new ring of the FAIR facility, a 1.1-kilometre superconducting accelerator in an underground tunnel that will accelerate ions of all elements to 99% of the speed of light. It is under construction, with beam commissioning planned for the second half of 2027.
summary.technical: SIS100: superconducting 100 Tm heavy-ion synchrotron (1100 m circumference, tunnel up to 17 m deep) of the first FAIR project stage with the Super-FRS and beam transport lines; injected from the SIS18; installation in the tunnels since early 2024, beam commissioning scheduled for the second half of 2027.
